For MomsLA families

Hi, MomsLA families.
Thanks for stopping by!

I’m Max, and I run Scan Squirrel here in Los Angeles. I help families digitize photos, albums, slides, negatives and the other things they want to keep.

I started after the fires. I scanned my own photos, then my family’s and my neighbors’. It grew into a small business that I really enjoy.

I pick up your collection, scan it locally, clean up the photos and return your originals. You get digital copies to enjoy and share. I give your collection the care I’d want for my own.

These are guidelines. Albums and delicate items need a closer look. I’ll talk through what you have and work out a price with you before I start. I’ll work with you on a price you’re happy with. I also offer discounts if you help spread the word about Scan Squirrel with a share on social media.

Advice is always free.

Want to scan them yourself? I’m happy to share tips. If you’d like me to do the work, tell me what you have and I’ll help you figure out a good way to start.

Keep my number handy.

If you have an emergency or need something scanned quickly, call or text me. I’ll tell you what I can do.

Tell me what you’d like to preserve.

A few photos, a full album, or boxes you’ve been meaning to open. Text me a photo of your collection, or just call and tell me about it. Please mention MomsLA.
